questions.stem: Why does the fragrance of an incense stick spread throughout a room?
choices: Because the particles are attracted to each other.
Because the particles are constantly moving and mixing with air.
Because the particles are very heavy.
Because the particles are very small and invisible.
questions.solution: The correct answer is that the particles are constantly moving and mixing with air. This is due to the kinetic nature of particles, which move freely in gases. The other options do not accurately explain the spreading of fragrance.

क्योंकि कण बहुत भारी होते हैं।
क्योंकि कण बहुत छोटे और अदृश्य होते हैं।

hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate scientific terminology in Hindi.

questions.stem: If two atoms of hydrogen combine, what do they form?
questions.solution: When two hydrogen atoms combine, they form a molecule because they share electrons to create a stable structure. A compound requires different elements, a mixture is a physical combination of substances, and an element is a single type of atom, not a combination.

hi.stem: यदि दो हाइड्रोजन परमाणु संयोजित होते हैं, तो वे क्या बनाते हैं?
hi.solution: जब दो हाइड्रोजन परमाणु संयोजित होते हैं, तो वे अणु बनाते हैं क्योंकि वे इलेक्ट्रॉनों के साझा करके स्थायी संरचना बनाते हैं। एक यौगिक में विभिन्न तत्व होते हैं, मिश्रण एक पदार्थ के भौतिक संयोजन होते हैं और एक तत्व एक ही प्रकार के परमाणु होते हैं, न कि संयोजन।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the scientific terminology used in Hindi textbooks.

mr.stem: जर दोन हायड्रोजन अणू एकत्र येत असतील, तर ते काय तयार करतात?
mr.solution: जेव्हा दोन हायड्रोजन अणू एकत्र येतात, तेव्हा ते अणू तयार करतात कारण ते इलेक्ट्रॉन शेअर करून एक स्थिर संरचना तयार करतात. एक यौगिक वेगवेगळ्या घटकांची आवश्यकता असते, मिश्रण हे पदार्थांचे भौतिक संयोजन असते आणि घटक हे एक प्रकारच्या अणूंचे एकत्र येणे नसते.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the scientific terminology appropriate for a Marathi-medium curriculum.

questions.stem: A student observed that the smell of a perfume spreads throughout a room quickly. What can be inferred about the particles of perfume?
choices: They move freely in all directions.
They move past each other in limited space.
questions.solution: The spreading of the perfume smell indicates that the particles are moving freely in all directions, which is a property of gas particles. Solids have stationary particles, and liquids have particles that move past each other in limited space. The correct answer is 'They move freely in all directions.'

वे सीमित स्थान में एक दूसरे के पास गतिमान हैं।

hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate scientific terminology as taught in Hindi-medium textbooks.

questions.stem: Why do gases mix easily with each other, while solids do not?
choices: Gases have more space between particles, so they can't mix easily.
Gases have weak interparticle forces, allowing free movement.
Solids have particles that move past each other.
questions.solution: Gases mix easily because their particles have weak interparticle forces and can move freely in all directions. Solids have strong interparticle forces and particles that are fixed in position, so they do not mix easily. The correct answer is 'Gases have weak interparticle forces, allowing free movement.'

गैसों में कणों के बीच कमजोर अंतर-कण बल होते हैं, जो स्वतंत्र गति की अनुमति देते हैं।
ठोसों में निश्चित आयतन होता है।
ठोसों में कण एक दूसरे के पास गति कर सकते हैं।
